subject: [RFC PATCH 02/18] splice: don't steal page cache folios

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's splice functionality to prevent it from stealing page cache folios, which are being reused without proper freeing. The patch removes the ->try_steal function from page_cache_pipe_buf_ops and instead copies the data when splicing from the page cache into a fuse file or virtio console. This change ensures that page cache memory is properly released after use, preventing potential issues with disk block reuse and file system corruption.
